accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 3 / honest_scope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The fitted-center law and its T_N=o(N) sufficiency are conditional on resolving Open-ended Question 1's compact-uniform O(N^{-1/2}) kink residual.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Diffusion-fitted Wald coverage is claimed conditional on the residual bound; exact-center joint inference and its Wald interval remain unconditional within the stated model class.

source_verification_receipts.locator: §2.3.1, Theorem 1; Appendix B.1, Theorem 3; §2.3.2 and Appendix B.2, Theorem 2/4
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The source states a T→∞ CLT with finite staffing and populations, separately develops a deterministic fluid model with fixed participant-to-server ratio, and says the fluid model cannot approximate estimator variance.
The paper proves O(lambda^{-1/2}) Wasserstein approximation of a stationary normalized M/Ph/n+M system by a piecewise OU diffusion, with moment bounds.
The paper introduces prelimit Markov-chain Poisson equations and finite-difference Stein factors for steady-state distribution approximation, illustrated by M/M/1.
The paper supplies functional-CLT rates for alpha-mixing triangular arrays and applications to contracting Markov chains under mixing and moment conditions.

The journal article studies likelihood-ratio steady-state sensitivity for countable-state CTMCs and establishes non-growing variance for centered likelihood-ratio estimators; the full theorem text is access-restricted, so no unverified theorem-level mismatch is asserted.
The cited article exists at the stated volume and pages and concerns variance reduction from estimating finite-dimensional nuisance parameters through score/estimating equations.
The source derives asymptotically optimal staffing for large M/M/N call centers and explicitly revisits square-root safety staffing under staffing and service-quality costs.

source_verification_receipts.version: SIAM Journal on Scientific and Statistical Computing 8(5), 1987
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives self-validating quadrature using interval computation to bound roundoff and truncation error.
The cited paper gives a derivative-free inclusion-function branch-and-bound method with rigorous bounds and rounding-error control for bound-constrained global optimization.
The source studies randomized experiments under stochastic congestion, including queue-informed estimators and inference in a single-queue setting.
The paper formalizes shared-state interference and proves DML conditions for efficient inference, including ADE and GATE applications.
